scripts.build: node scripts/patch-highlightjs-exports.mjs && node scripts/gen-omp-settings-schema.mjs && node scripts/gen-omp-slash-commands.mjs && node scripts/gen-pi-slash-commands.mjs && electron-vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs && npm run dugite:git && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run dist:win:x64 && npm run dist:win:arm64
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run pack:win:x64
scripts.dist:win:x64:fast: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run pack:win:x64:fast
scripts.pack:win:x64: node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs win32 x64 && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs x64 && node scripts/pack.mjs --win --x64 -c.npmRebuild=false
scripts.pack:win:x64:fast: node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs win32 x64 && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs x64 && node scripts/pack.mjs 1 --win --x64 -c.npmRebuild=false
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs win32 arm64 && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs arm64 && electron-builder --win --arm64 -c.npmRebuild=true --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:mac:arm64 && npm run dist:mac:x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs darwin arm64 && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 -c.npmRebuild=false --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs darwin x64 && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs x64 && npx --yes @electron/rebuild --force --only=node-pty --arch=x64 && electron-builder --mac --x64 -c.npmRebuild=false --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs linux x64 && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs x64 && electron-builder --linux --x64 -c.npmRebuild=false --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/build-omp-worker.mjs && npm run dugite:git && electron-builder --dir
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/install-electron.mjs && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs && node scripts/patch-highlightjs-exports.mjs && electron-builder install-app-deps
